# QA image fixture

`hopper.jpg` (6412 bytes, 128 × 128): real photographic JPEG fixture from the Pillow project, downloaded 2026-11-08 from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/python-pillow/Pillow/main/Tests/images/hopper.jpg . The photograph depicts Grace Hopper and is a US government public-domain photograph. Tests also use the retained IT-Tools `upstream/public/banner.png`, under the retained upstream license. WebP/transparent PNG variants are derived locally for format verification; no user images are included.
